# nvim-dap runtime

Huyang ships the Lua runtime from [mfussenegger/nvim-dap](https://github.com/mfussenegger/nvim-dap) at commit `c9a0738e45f1bd41d792a126941348dce661cf9b`.

The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`. Update the copied `lua/dap.lua`, `lua/dap/`, and `plugin/dap.lua` files together when advancing this dependency.
